alerts.condition: Oldest due work above five minutes for ten minutes
alerts.rationale: The threshold and duration are exact. Eligible due timestamps support a read-only aggregate, but no collector currently emits the gauge.

alerts.rationale: The expression measures a positive 30-minute gauge slope. The reference summary can support a collector, but none is wired.

alerts.condition: Expired evidence on an active binding
alerts.rationale: Activation depends on current passing capability, control-plane, DNS and live-conformance checks. No normative gauge exposes active-binding evidence expiry.

alerts.condition: Drift removes exact-domain catch-all or feedback routing

Expired nonce rows are queryable, but section 14 defines no nonce-lag metric and the service has no operational collector.
The signal must exclude referenced and legally held blobs. No normative retention-lag metric or safe aggregate producer currently exists.
